technicalFAQ.sectionSubtitle: Answers to common questions indie developers and startups have about using the template, choosing the architecture, and shipping to production.

faqs.question: What tech stack and frameworks are included?
faqs.answer: The template is built on full-stack Next.js 16 (App Router), NextAuth.js authentication, Resend email service, Neon Serverless Postgres (Drizzle ORM), and the Stripe subscription SDK.

faqs.question: Is this SaaS template fully open source and free?
faqs.answer: Yes! The base version is 100% MIT licensed. You are free to use it for commercial projects, personal development, or client delivery—no royalty or licensing fees required.

faqs.question: How do I quickly deploy and ship the project?
faqs.answer: Just fork the repo, clone it locally, configure environment variables (e.g. Neon Postgres connection string and Stripe API keys), then deploy to Vercel, Cloud Run, or your own Docker server with a single command.

faqs.question: How do I configure and test Stripe payments?
faqs.answer: We provide pre-built API routes and webhook event handlers. Just grab your Test/Live API keys and Webhook Secret from the Stripe dashboard, drop them into .env, and the monthly/annual subscription flow lights up automatically.
